$comment: Fictional compound risk rules for the demo. Each rule adds bonus points when all its conditions are met by visible answers. Evaluated by the App 2 PCF component only.

riskRules.name: Fluid leak with no fire extinguisher
riskRules.explanation: A leak is a fire load; without an extinguisher there is no first response.

riskRules.name: Hydraulic leak with no spill kit
riskRules.explanation: Fluid on the floor that nobody can contain is a slip hazard for everyone nearby.

riskRules.name: Brakes and warning devices both failed
riskRules.explanation: The truck can't stop in distance and can't warn pedestrians either.

riskRules.name: Damaged mast with stretched chains
riskRules.explanation: Two lifting faults together raise the chance of a dropped load.

riskRules.name: Missing guards and blocked emergency stops
riskRules.explanation: Exposed nip points with no reachable stop is the classic entrapment case.

riskRules.name: Hot motor with a torn belt
riskRules.explanation: A torn belt adds drag to a motor that is already running hot.
